bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 3 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Bionik Boyz
bonuses.text: A number of ORK Threats equal to the Tier of the game that accompany the Painboy may have Bioniks.

bonuses.name: 'Ere We Go!
bonuses.text: If this Threat is Engaged at the start of its Turn, it gains +2 damage to melee attacks.

abilities.name: Wetwork
abilities.text: The Painboy uses their Dok's Tools on an ally and makes an attack using one of its weapons, ignoring the Multi-Action DN penalty.

abilities.name: Dok's Tools
abilities.text: The Painboy makes a DN 3 Medicae (Int) Test on an ally as a Simple Action. Every Shifted Exalted Icon causes the target to recover 1 additional Wound. If the Painboy rolls a Complication, the Test fails, and the target suffers an additional Wound.
'Urty Syringe is printed without a Range: "8 +2 ED / Rending (6)".

abilities.name: Kwik Fix
abilities.text: The Painboy uses its Dok's Tools Simple Action.
